**Claim:** session `session_01Jmxdo7bmeqCQHLSfmLVX9w` · branch `claude/issue-8600-valuedatasource-filter-text-cases` · 2026-09-08T23:54Z.

⭐ This is a **PM dispatch**: this seat set the assignee and posts this claim on the dev's behalf. The dev inherits both, checks that the newest `Claim:` names its branch, ⛔ posts no second claim and ⛔ never writes the assignee field.

### Why this card, and why now — the order is measured, not assumed

The lane's full order puts **#8221** first (p2, type `Bug`, older). It is **not** being taken, and the reason has changed since the last seat wrote one:

- Its deferral note (`5573616429`, 2026-09-07T16:49Z) parks it behind **PR #8372**. ⛔ That reason is **stale**: #8372 **merged** at 2026-09-07T23:04:10Z (read back from GitHub 23:50Z).
- The live blocker is a different one, measured just now on `origin/main` `da5e4f69`: option B narrows `sort` to the array arm, and the string arm is declared at `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:194`, `:826`, `:1021` — **a file the #8317 dev has modified in its worktree right now**. ⇒ file-granularity collision, ⛔ not a precautionary serialisation.

I am recording that on #8221 itself rather than only here, because a card whose deferral note names a merged PR is a card the next seat re-derives from scratch.

Every other p2 in this lane is held too: **#8318** on `#7735` de-defaulting (#8317 has `zod-mirror-authors-no-defaults-7735.test.ts` open), **#8499** and **#7759** on `src/zod/**` and `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` (PR #8553), **#8347** ⛔ barred on its stale figure, **#8345**/**#8327** are this seat's own remainders. ⇒ **#8600 is the highest-priority card on a free file surface** — `packages/core/src/adapters/**`, which no live PR holds.

### Carrier hung at dispatch, ⛔ deliberately, before the PR exists

`needs:contract-review` is on this card now. The card names the risk itself: `like` / `ilike` are refused **by name** in this adapter (#7383), the table may declare them, and PR #8599's type gate «must not quietly re-open». Enrolling a face in a published conformance table can **move its accept set** ⇒ 强制条款②.

⛔ I am not pre-judging that it moves. A verified "the accept set did **not** move" is exactly what clears this carrier — but an unreviewed accept-set change is a contract breach, so the carrier goes on first and comes off on evidence. It will be hung on the PR the moment one exists (双载体).

### What is NOT settled by this dispatch

⛔ Whether enrolment is even the right step. The card's own instruction stands: read **rule 2** in `packages/spec/src/data/filter-text-conformance.ts` (the local `../objectstack` checkout — the file, ⛔ not a ruling comment) and determine whether "the gap" is shut. If it is not, the deliverable is a precise statement of what remains open, ⛔ not an enrolment forced through.

### Notes carried into the brief

⭐ Both hand-mirrored fixtures **stay** as lit controls; a table-driven suite that passes because the table is empty or the import resolved to something inert is the failure mode this repo has measured repeatedly. ⚠️ And ablation legs are classified **per test from vitest's JSON reporter** — a signature list plus `grep -c` over the text reporter has been measured twice to read a fully dead run as a clean one (#8593, #8452).

⛔ **Dedup is declared, not claimed** — the filing seat could not run one, and this seat inherits that limit rather than papering over it.

## Step 1 verdict: the gap is NOT shut. No enrolment was forced; nothing was landed.

Branch `claude/issue-8600-valuedatasource-filter-text-cases` pushed at `da5e4f69` (identical to `origin/main`, zero commits) as the claim's landing marker and the write-routing probe. No PR, per the dispatch's own instruction for this branch of step 1.

### The measurement that decided it

Every case of the **published** table driven through a real `ValueDataSource` over `FILTER_TEXT_ROWS`:

| | count |
|---|---|
| evaluated cases (`expected` is a row list) | 14 of 14 **PASS** |
| rejection cases (`expectRejection: true`) | 0 of 5 pass — **5 FAIL** |

Discrimination evidence, so this is not an inert run: population floor `cases=19 rows=9`, the named member `"$contains is case-SENSITIVE — a lower-case comparand misses the upper-case row"` present, and the run produced **14 agreements and 5 disagreements** from one comparison function. An empty or inert table yields zero lines; a broken comparator yields all-pass or all-fail. Neither happened.

### Blocker A — the published table does not contain the rows the deferral was about

- `packages/core/package.json` declares `"@objectstack/spec": "^17.2.0"`; installed and resolved: **17.3.0**.
- `import { FILTER_TEXT_CASES, FILTER_TEXT_ROWS } from '@objectstack/spec/data'` yields **19 cases**, and `Object.keys(FILTER_TEXT_ROWS[0])` is `["id","name"]`.
- objectstack `main`, `packages/spec/src/data/filter-text-conformance.ts`: **24 cases**, and the row interface carries `score: number`.
- The five #14079 rows are on objectstack main and **not in the published artifact objectui consumes**.

Consequence: `ValueDataSource.nonStringStoredValue.test.ts` (#8452 / PR #8599) is today the **only** thing in objectui pinning the non-string-stored-value behaviour. Enrolling now and retiring it would silently drop that coverage — the exact drift this card exists to prevent, inverted.

Forward reading, so the PM knows how much of the gap is actually the face's: the five unpublished #14079 rows, transcribed verbatim from objectstack main and driven through the same adapter, are **5 of 5 PASS**, with two live controls (`{ name: { $contains: 'acme' } }` returns `["2"]`, `{ score: { $eq: 5 } }` returns `["1"]`) proving the fixture is not inert. **PR #8599's half of the gap is shut on the face; it is only unreachable from the table.**

### Blocker B and C — the per-row executability table

The five open rows are all in the rejection family. `envelope` means: did it throw an ADR-0112 error carrying `code: 'INVALID_FILTER'`.

| # | row | executable here? | measured answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1–14 | every evaluated case, `$icontains` folding + ASCII boundary + literal `%` `_` `.` + the case-sensitive `$contains` family + the infix `icontains` door + `$notContains` | **yes** | exact row-set match, 14 of 14 |
| 15 | `$regex` is REFUSED, the refusal names `$icontains` | verdict yes, **envelope no** | rows `[]`, one console refusal quoting `RETIRED_FILTER_OPERATORS`; `mustMention` satisfied by the log text; **no throw, no code** |
| 16 | `$regex` with `$options` REFUSED as one mistake | verdict yes, **envelope no, and mustMention FAILS** | rows `[]`, one refusal naming `$regex` only. `$options` is **never mentioned** — the dollar-dialect loop returns on the first refused operator |
| 17 | a dangling `$options` with no `$regex` is REFUSED | verdict yes, **envelope no** | rows `[]`, refusal names `$options` and `$icontains`; no throw, no code |
| 18 | an empty `$icontains` comparand is REFUSED | **NO — not refused at all** | **returns ALL NINE rows**, zero console lines. A predicate that constrains nothing |
| 19 | a non-string `$icontains` comparand is REFUSED | **NO — not refused at all** | `String(42)` becomes `'42'`, evaluated, returns `[]`, zero console lines — indistinguishable from "evaluated, matched nothing" |

Rows 15–17 are a **mechanism** mismatch: the adapter refuses by excluding the row and logging once per distinct refusal per `find()`, deliberately, documented at objectui#7349 and contrasted in its own docblock with `@object-ui/data-objectstack`, which throws `MalformedFilterError`. Rows 18–19 are **wrong answers**, not a mechanism difference.

A skipped row would be a hole, so neither of these is proposed as a skip; and rows 15–19 cannot honestly be declared inapplicable either, because the face **is** asked them and does answer — three correctly by verdict, two wrongly. That is why option C above is rejected by measurement rather than left on the table.

### Accept-set finding: it did **NOT** move

Zero code changed, so nothing a caller could pass changed. Three independent readings of that: `git status --porcelain` empty, `git diff HEAD` empty, and `check-changeset-presence` reporting on its own line `0 file(s) changed`.

What enrolment **would** move, measured as FROM readings, each paired with a well-formed control that still succeeds — a face that refuses everything would otherwise pass for conformance:

| probe | FROM (today) | control | control answer |
|---|---|---|---|
| `{ name: { $icontains: '' } }` | **all nine rows** | `{ name: { $icontains: 'acme' } }` | `["1","2"]` — still succeeds |
| `['name','icontains','']` (AST door) | **all nine rows** | `['name','icontains','acme']` | `["1","2"]` — still succeeds |
| `{ name: { $icontains: 42 } }` | `[]`, evaluated not refused | `{ name: { $icontains: '42' } }` | `[]` — the well-formed string comparand gives the SAME answer, which is exactly why the coercion is invisible |
| `{ name: { $regex: 'ac.*' } }` | `[]` + 1 console refusal, no throw | `{ name: { $contains: 'acme' } }` | `["2"]` — still succeeds |
| `{ name: { $options: 'i' } }` | `[]` + 1 console refusal, no throw | same as above | `["2"]` |
| `{ name: { $like: 'ac%' } }` / `$ilike` | `[]` + refusal "not implemented by the in-memory matcher" | same as above | `["2"]` |

The producer risk that makes row 18 a ruling rather than a bug fix: `packages/fields/src/widgets/FilterConditionField.tsx` line 166 emits `{ [field]: { $icontains: value } }` verbatim for the `containsCaseInsensitive` operator. `condToMongo` returns null only when the FIELD is missing; `filterGroupToMongo` drops only null fragments. **There is no empty-value guard on that path.** So a builder row with the operator chosen and the value box still empty produces exactly the shape the table says must be refused — and refusing it flips that list from "every row" to "no rows", which this adapter's own `$exists` arm names as the one outcome worse than the bug. The search-box path was checked separately and is **not** affected: `ListView` gates on `searchTerm` being truthy and emits `$search`, which the adapter answers in its own arm.

### Ablation — a declared deviation, with the reason measured

The dispatch asked for an on-disk mutation of one table row "in your worktree only". **That is not achievable here, and the attempt would have corrupted two other agents' runs.** The table ships inside `node_modules`, and pnpm hardlinks it:

- `node_modules/.pnpm/@objectstack+spec@17.3.0_.../dist/data/index.mjs` — inode `16023626`, **link count 4**.
- `find -inum 16023626` names the other holders: `/home/user/objectui-issue-8317` and `/home/user/objectui-review-8646`, both live agent worktrees, plus the store copy.

Substituted an in-memory ablation over the same comparison function, and reported the real run's own discrimination as the primary evidence:

- baseline: row `$contains is case-SENSITIVE — a lower-case comparand...` wants `["2"]`, got `["2"]` — GREEN
- ablated: same row with `expected` mutated to `["1","2"]` — **RED**, naming that row
- restored: original object untouched, `expected` still `["2"]` — GREEN

There is no enrolled suite to redden, because none was landed; that is stated as NOT MEASURED below rather than dressed up.

Restoration proved by hash — the two probe files written during measurement were removed and the tree returned to `HEAD`:

| file | worktree sha256 (first 16) | HEAD sha256 (first 16) | match |
|---|---|---|---|
| `packages/core/src/adapters/ValueDataSource.ts` | `df29ade98a7e5227` | `df29ade98a7e5227` | YES |
| `.../__tests__/ValueDataSource.textOperatorCase.test.ts` | `16a4b7235c81c752` | `16a4b7235c81c752` | YES |
| `.../__tests__/ValueDataSource.nonStringStoredValue.test.ts` | `716aa03cc753ae95` | `716aa03cc753ae95` | YES |

plus `git status --porcelain` empty and `git diff HEAD` empty at `da5e4f69`.

### Gates — every one with its exit code, captured before any pipe

| gate | exit | reading |
|---|---|---|
| `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/core^...' build` | **0** | prerequisite for type-check |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core type-check` | **0** | first attempt was **2** with TS6305 "Output file has not been built from source file" — a PREREQUISITE NOT MET, reported as such, not as a red gate; green after the closure build |
| the two card fixtures, via `pnpm exec vitest run` from the **repo root** | **0** | `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 31 passed (31)` — a real population, not a zero-match false green. A package-dir `vitest` run is refused outright by objectui#3378's guard |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/core lint` | **0** | 0 errors, 532 warnings |
| `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | **0** | "0 file(s) changed ... no changeset is owed" |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | **0** | 6881 tracked text files scanned, 85 binary skipped |
| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/cli... build` | **0** | prerequisite for `pnpm check` |
| `pnpm check` | **0** | first attempt exit **1**, `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` — PREREQUISITE NOT MET, the CLI dist was absent; green after the build |

Heavy runs went through the container's shared verify lock (`OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=os-dev-issue-8600`); the first turn waited 353s behind the issue-8317 agent, and the VERDICT line was read rather than a bare exit status.

**Changeset: none, and none is owed.** Rule applied: `check-changeset-presence`'s own criterion — a changeset is owed when published source or a published contract of a released package moves in the range. Zero files changed, so nothing moved. This is the measured branch of AGENTS.md's changeset rule, not a `skip-changeset` claim.

### NOT MEASURED — explicitly

- **`check:published-dist`** — measured here or nowhere, and **not measured**. `published-dist-gate.yml` states in its own header that it is deliberately NOT a pull-request job: the only false-red-free criterion is over the built artifact, so it must build all 39 published packages, and the gate sits on the release path. It does not fit the foreground budget on a contended shared box, and against a zero-file diff it could only have produced a baseline reading of `main`.

- **`Build Docs`** — not measured.
- **CI as a whole** — **there is no PR**, so none of these gates will run in CI for this work at all. Every reading above is measured here or nowhere in the operative sense.
- **The enrolled suite's ablation** — there is no enrolled suite, so there is nothing to mutate and nothing to redden. The in-memory substitute above is reported as what it is.
- **Whether rows 18 and 19 reproduce against a real driver** — out of scope; this is the in-memory face only.
- **Dedupe search for the two live wrong answers** — deliberately not run, because they are not being filed as separate cards; the reason is in `out_of_scope_findings`.

### Carriers

`needs:contract-review` remains on this card, untouched, exactly as the PM hung it at dispatch. The second carrier does not exist because **there is no PR** — that is the one part of the 双载体 instruction that cannot be satisfied, and it is reported rather than worked around. Nothing was enqueued, no auto-merge armed, nothing marked ready.
